================================================================================================
M2 L3 'WRITING THE RULE' — tuning harness, shipped constants, shipped reducer
================================================================================================
SHARE dial 0-60% in 5s · REINVEST dial 0-40% in 5s · PRICE $10-$120 in $2s
4 market profiles · 3-week season · 3 offer rounds · two-thirds within ±10

PASS  P1 — BC-1a the DIFFERENTIAL REINVEST RESPONSE moves >= 2 dial steps in every market (worst: 3)
        new-york        r* across shares 0%/5%/10%/15%/20%/25%/30%/35%/40%/45%/50%/55%/60%: 25% 25% 15% 15% 15% 15% 15% 15% 15% 15% 10% 10% 5%  → 4 dial steps
        golden-state    r* across shares 0%/5%/10%/15%/20%/25%/30%/35%/40%/45%/50%/55%/60%: 30% 30% 30% 30% 20% 20% 20% 15% 15% 15% 15% 15% 15%  → 3 dial steps
        oklahoma-city   r* across shares 0%/5%/10%/15%/20%/25%/30%/35%/40%/45%/50%/55%/60%: 35% 35% 35% 35% 35% 25% 25% 10% 10% 10% 10% 10% 10%  → 5 dial steps
        memphis         r* across shares 0%/5%/10%/15%/20%/25%/30%/35%/40%/45%/50%/55%/60%: 20% 20% 20% 20% 20% 15% 15% 15% 15% 15% 5% 5% 5%  → 3 dial steps
        The mechanism, stated so it is falsifiable: a club keeps kappa(s) = 1 - s(N-1)/N of every extra local dollar, Draw is bought with square-root returns, so the optimal spend goes as kappa^2 — the (1-s)^2 form the charter names. Nothing above is computed from that algebra: every number is a brute force over the shipped dial through the shipped settlement.

PASS  P2 — BC-1b at least one market's best PRICE moves with the share, at least one capacity-bound market's does not, and sharing never RAISES a price
        new-york        p* $64 $64 $64 $64 $64 $64 $64 $64 $64 $64 $64 $64 $64  Δ$0  fill at p*(0): 100% (19812/19812, turned away 308)
        golden-state    p* $68 $68 $68 $68 $68 $68 $68 $68 $68 $68 $68 $68 $68  Δ$0  fill at p*(0): 98.7% (17836/18064, turned away 0)
        oklahoma-city   p* $54 $54 $54 $54 $54 $52 $52 $52 $50 $50 $50 $48 $48  Δ$6  fill at p*(0): 55.1% (10023/18203, turned away 0)
        memphis         p* $46 $46 $46 $46 $44 $44 $44 $44 $42 $42 $42 $40 $38  Δ$8  fill at p*(0): 47.5% (8458/17794, turned away 0)
        moved: oklahoma-city, memphis · flat: new-york, golden-state · flat AND >=97% full: new-york, golden-state
        The flat arrow is the teaching object, not a defect: under a binding capacity clamp the optimum sits where the building fills, and a tax on what you sell cannot move a quantity you cannot increase.

PASS  P3 — BC-1c the price movement is caused by the untaxed stream, and vanishes when that stream is deleted
        new-york        shipped model Δ$0 · with the untaxed in-arena stream DELETED Δ$0 (must be $0)
        golden-state    shipped model Δ$0 · with the untaxed in-arena stream DELETED Δ$0 (must be $0)
        oklahoma-city   shipped model Δ$6 · with the untaxed in-arena stream DELETED Δ$0 (must be $0)
        memphis         shipped model Δ$8 · with the untaxed in-arena stream DELETED Δ$0 (must be $0)
        A uniformly taxed base cannot move an argmax — scaling a function by a positive constant does not move its maximiser. This is the arithmetic `l3-arith-harness` published, and it is the reason the module leaves one real revenue stream out of the pot.

PASS  P4 — NO DOMINANT PROPOSAL — own-best shares differ by market, a pure headcount room cannot carry a rule, a traded room can, and copying the median costs real seats real money
        New York        BIG MARKET    own best share   0%  (season money at 0% / 30% / 60%: $13,216,338 / $12,123,788 / $10,918,944)
        Memphis         SMALL MARKET  own best share  60%  (season money at 0% / 30% / 60%: $5,269,430 / $6,094,480 / $6,740,845)

        New Orleans     SMALL MARKET  own best share  60%  (season money at 0% / 30% / 60%: $5,592,751 / $6,361,925 / $7,001,814)
        Chicago         BIG MARKET    own best share   0%  (season money at 0% / 30% / 60%: $11,279,024 / $10,418,327 / $8,927,745)
        distinct own-best shares across the room: 0%, 55%, 60% — a room where one number were best for everybody would be a vote with a correct answer, which is the contract's guess-the-teacher trap
        HEADCOUNT room (every big market at 0%, every small market at 60%): statusQuo at 5%, 0/8 needed — voting your type cannot carry a rule, so the two sides have to trade
        TRADED room (big markets 20%, small markets 30%): voted at 25% — the supermajority forces a deal, it does not forbid one
        seats strictly worse off copying the middle of the dial (30%) than reading their own club: 12 of 12, worst $1,092,550 at New York
        HONEST LIMIT, ledgered in SIMPLIFICATIONS: the big markets' own best share is 0%. The design hoped for an interior optimum above zero for every market; at the shipped constants that does not hold, because a capacity-bound building (BC-1b's flat arrow) is barely exposed to a weak visitor. The module never claims otherwise on any surface.

PASS  P5 — ADOPTION MECHANICS — two-thirds passes, a split room falls to a legitimate status quo, and one desk's influence is bounded
        clustered 25/30/35 → voted at 30%, 9/9 inside ±10
        split 0/30/60 → statusQuo at 5%, 3/6 needed
        one desk sweeping the dial against a room at 20%: 0→20 5→20 10→20 15→20 20→20 25→20 30→20 35→20 40→20 45→20 50→20 55→20 60→20 (* = status quo)
        adopted shares reachable by one desk alone: 20 — bounded influence, not a hijack

PASS  P6 — THE DIFFERENTIAL-RESPONSE SCALE is material (>=1/3 of the dial at the median profile) and the CONDITION is consequence-bearing
        new-york        condition OFF 25 25 15 15 15 15 15 15 15 15 10 10  5 | ON 25 25 15 15 15 15 15 15 15 15 15 15 15 | differs at 3 of 13 shares
        golden-state    condition OFF 30 30 30 30 20 20 20 15 15 15 15 15 15 | ON 30 30 30 30 20 20 20 15 15 15 15 15 15 | differs at 0 of 13 shares
        oklahoma-city   condition OFF 35 35 35 35 35 25 25 10 10 10 10 10 10 | ON 35 35 35 35 35 25 25 25 10 10 10 10 10 | differs at 1 of 13 shares
        memphis         condition OFF 20 20 20 20 20 15 15 15 15 15  5  5  5 | ON 20 20 20 20 20 15 15 15 15 15 15 15  5 | differs at 2 of 13 shares
        drop as a fraction of the whole dial, per profile: 50% 38% 63% 38% (median 50%)
        BC-6 fix 1: the CONDITION changed the cash-best reinvest at 6 (profile × share) points. Stage-0 shipped a control that changed nothing in 0 of 14 configurations, and that was the one honesty defect the play review said it would block a selection on.

PASS  P7 — NO UNWINNABLE SEAT (R5) across 780 reachable (profile × share × draw-pair) cases, before any pot payout
        thinnest margin anywhere: $52,616 at oklahoma-city share 60% draws 10/10
        The national check is unconditional and the pot never touches it — which is also the lesson.

PASS  P8 — THE POT IDENTITY closes every week on both branches of the condition (drift bounded by one rounding unit per club)
        share 10% condition OFF → adopted 10% · pot $1,836,046/week · rounding drift <= 2 · clubs docked at some point: 0
        share 30% condition OFF → adopted 30% · pot $5,508,137/week · rounding drift <= 5 · clubs docked at some point: 0
        share 60% condition OFF → adopted 60% · pot $11,016,277/week · rounding drift <= 1 · clubs docked at some point: 0
        share 10% condition ON  → adopted 10% · pot $1,836,046/week · rounding drift <= 2 · clubs docked at some point: 8
        share 30% condition ON  → adopted 30% · pot $5,363,128/week · rounding drift <= 0 · clubs docked at some point: 8
        share 60% condition ON  → adopted 60% · pot $10,726,258/week · rounding drift <= 2 · clubs docked at some point: 8

PASS  P9 — CLAIM AUDIT — 438 atoms across 109 surfaces in 4 rooms agree with the reducer in BINDING, SIGN, QUANTIFIER, BOUND and LEVEL, proven non-vacuous by 5 mutations
        voted 40% condition ON, seeded from L2         28 surfaces · 115 atoms · 0 problems
        voted 10% condition OFF, unseeded              28 surfaces · 109 atoms · 0 problems
        status-quo room (0/30/60, nobody moves), seeded 25 surfaces · 103 atoms · 0 problems
        league office's rule, never voted              28 surfaces · 111 atoms · 0 problems
        claim-carrying surfaces shipping ZERO atoms (allowed only where nothing is computed from state): 1 — synthesis:subsidy-coda
        MUTATION SIGN: flip a non-negative atom's value negative → CAUGHT
        MUTATION QUANTIFIER: flip a quantifier's predicate against the reducer → CAUGHT
        MUTATION BOUND: push a bounded atom past its own printed ceiling → CAUGHT
        MUTATION NOUN: rename the thing a claim is about, so the rendered substring no longer appears in its sentence → CAUGHT
        MUTATION LEVEL: print the wrong direction for the room's own effort → CAUGHT

PASS  P10 — DETERMINISM — the same session replays to the same numbers and the module source contains no random source (R7)
        adopted rule on both runs: 5% · condition OFF · rookie at Indiana
